digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler outbound differ, Jira DataCenter text field truncation
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for comment and description truncation that verify second-pass idempotence, unlike Cloud which has two such suites to prevent re-emission of oversized values

DC's sanitize_comment binds both comment and description limits to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) per jira.text.field.character.limit property covering both field types, but this binding lacks provenance documentation

Convergence tests driven through compute_outbound_mutations or _diff_comments can silently fall back to Cloud's backend via config if mappers/sanitizers are not explicitly injected, causing tests to pass while measuring Cloud behavior instead of DC

DC's comment and description truncation limits are both correctly 32767 (the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit per jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519), not an assumption that needs reverification

The two DC convergence suites require identity/recording assertions for comments and value-based discriminators for descriptions to prove the correct backend path was exercised, not value-only assertions that would pass under either sanitizer
